feeds.title: Walking for Health and Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Walking for Health and Fitness is a health, fitness, and wellness website dedicated to walking and all the physical, psychological, and spiritual benefits that come from it in order to achieve a healthy, balanced lifestyle.

feeds.title: Northern Pies
feeds.description: This is a personal blog mainly to do with hillwalking things but with other stuff as well.....maybe the odd rant.

feeds.title: M&G Go For A Walk
feeds.description: A blog about the walking activities of Mick & Gayle, from short strolls to big walks, interspersed with other random thoughts about things outdoor-related.

feeds.title: NEARLY UPHILL
feeds.description: NEARLY UPHILL blog is all about walking in Snowdonia and the Clwydian Range, it includes handy checklists for helping you walk as many peaks in North Wales as you can!

feeds.title: Rambling Man
feeds.description: Walking the UK's long distance footpaths, one at a time. Rambling Man is a website dedicated to telling the tales of one Andrew Bowden as he walks some of those paths.

feeds.title: Beating The Bounds
feeds.description: A blog about walking, thinking about walking, reading about walking, and maybe other stuff. By a father of three, teacher of mathematics, and cantankerous git.

feeds.title: America Walks Blog
feeds.description: America Walks is a leading national nonprofit that advances safe, equitable, accessible, and enjoyable places to walk and move by giving people and communities the resources to effectively advocate for change. We are a national voice on walking and walkable communities and work to increase the visibility and demand for public places that allow all people to move and walk in ways that are safe and make the most sense for them.

feeds.title: Bristol Nordic Walking Blog
feeds.description: Join our expert instructors and learn how to turn walking into an effective total body workout.Bristol & Bath Nordic Walking started in 2010 and has gone from strength to strength. Our instructors are friendly and professional, we offer regular weekly classes and have an ever increasing group of walkers. Our aim is to spread the word about just how effective and fun this total body workout is.

feeds.title: Ruth's Coastal Walk (UK)
feeds.description: My name is Ruth Livingstone. In 2010 I decided to start walking around the coastline of the British mainland. I'd never done any long-distance hiking before! But once I started, I was hooked. This blog documents my walks around the coast, starting in North Norfolk, and heading clockwise around the shore. I follow paths and tracks, take plenty of breaks for photographs and snacks, and in general I make very slow progress.

feeds.title: Walkers' Britain Blog
feeds.description: We offered our first walking tour in England in 1973 as Sherpa Expeditions and since then have amassed an unrivaled wealth of experience researching, designing, and operating innovative active holidays in the UK and in Europe. With over four decades of traveller feedback to help us refine our tours, you can trust us to give you the very best walking or cycling experience.

feeds.title: Conrad Walks
feeds.description: My blog nick-name is SIR HUGH. I'm not from the aristocracy - my middle name is Hugh which relates to the list of 282 hills in Scotland compiled by Sir Hugh Munro in 1891. I climbed my last one (Sgurr Mor) on 28th June 2009. This blog features mainly my walking exploits interspersed with other random topics.

feeds.title: Inspiration Outdoors Blog
feeds.description: We offer guided and self guided walking tours through Western Australia's most beautiful natural areas. For those who prefer a little comfort on their walks.

feeds.title: My Walking Coach Blog
feeds.description: Michele Stanten, a walking coach and ACE-certified fitness instructor, has been motivating people to be more active for over 25 years.Michele launched mywalkingcoach.com to help people lead healthier, happier lives. She believes that walking can be the first step to making exercise a habit, which can have positive effects on all areas of your life.

feeds.title: Lonewalker Blog
feeds.description: This is the walking diary of Lonewalker. My real name is Stuart Greig and I'm an IT consultant specialising in the delivery of Salesforce solutions, working for a Manchester-based systems integrator. I walk the hills at weekends and try and spend at least two weeks of every year completing a long distance path somewhere in the UK.

feeds.title: Walking is Fitness
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Dave. Walking has improved my health. I think better. I'm more creative. Walking calms my stress. And, these aren't benefits unique to just me. They are available to everyone. There's plenty of science and research to back that up. That's one of the topics I cover regularly with this blog.

feeds.title: FellBound
feeds.description: The ramblings and rantings of a 60s something hill walker.

feeds.title: alan sloman's big walk
feeds.description: Sixty something beardy bloke who, thanks to my incredible siblings David and Megan, now has four kidneys. I walked the length of Britain in 2007 and walk across Scotland every year on the TGO Challenge. Follow along my journey.

feeds.title: Fiona Outdoors » Walking
feeds.description: I'm Fiona Russell. I am an outdoors and adventure journalist, blogger and vlogger. I run, walk, cycle, swim, ski and love most things outdoors.

feeds.title: She walks in England
feeds.description: A blog all about walks and hikes in England. I'm a 30-something physiotherapist working full time in London. I've always been kind of adventurous, but it wasn't until I hit 30 that I started walking and hiking my way around England. I love a good walk in the English countryside, and here I tell you all about them and how you can do them too.

feeds.title: The Nordic Walking Queen Blog
feeds.description: Empowering your walk with Nordic Walking Poles. My name is Linda Lemke, known in the Twin Cities and beyond as the Nordic Walking Queen. I've been in the outdoor recreation industry for more than 25 years, specializing in women's and children's activities.

feeds.title: London Wlogger
feeds.description: I'm Stu, a 30 year old walking enthusiast who loves exploring London! For me, it's one of the greatest places in the world. It encapsulates the old and the new perfectly. Whether that's the heritage of Tower Bridge to the modern day architecture of The Shard, rarely can you visit a city where both fit together so well.

feeds.title: Wander Girl Walks
feeds.description: There is no better way to explore a new country or region than on foot, where you can take in the sights, sounds, scents, and scenery first-hand. As avid walkers, we've collected our favorite walking tours in some of the most visited hiker and pilgrim routes around Hungary.

feeds.title: The Walking Woman Blog
feeds.description: Create bespoke walking adventures in the UK. I'm Katherine Grugeon and I love walking in the great British outdoors. I'm a qualified mountain leader, navigation tutor award holder with an outdoor first aid qualification and I'm fully insured to take you walking. With my dog Polly I travel around the UK to walk up hills, mountains and on moorland.

feeds.title: Charles Hawes
feeds.description: Charles Hawes writes a frank and sometimes outspoken account of walks in the UK and beyond. Writing this blog is for the enjoyment of writing -- well, and as a rather special and focused diary of some of my best walks. I started it in 2012 when I started walking the newly opened 870 miles Wales

feeds.title: I'm Just Walkin'
feeds.description: I'm walking every street in New York City. Follow along my journey.

feeds.title: MyFitnessPal Blog » Walking
feeds.description: Articles on the benefits of walking. MyFitnessPal is the leading resource in nutrition tracking.
